findings.description: Ignacio Alvarado and Teodosia Durán of San José, Costa Rica had a legitimate daughter, Angela Alvarado Durán, born about April 1879 and buried 20 June 1880 at El Carmen, San José at the age of one year and two months.

target_person.name: Angela Alvarado Durán
target_person.birth: about April 1879 — stated as one year and two months old at her 20 Jun 1880 burial; baptized 27 Mar 1879 at San Vicente Ferrer
target_person.burial: 20 June 1880, El Carmen, San José, Costa Rica

details.mother: Teodosia Durán — the woman the starting tree carries twice, as Teodosia Duran (K4JL-NPF, b. 1876) and Teodora Durán (K21K-P18). The tree's 1876 birth year is unsourced and impossible: she is bearing children in this parish from 1881 onward and buries two infants in 1880 and 1884.

supporting_sources: Costa Rica, registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1595-2022 — baptism of Angela Procesa Maria de las Piedades Alvarado Duran, 27 Mar 1879, San Vicente Ferrer, San Vicente, San José, daughter of Ygnacio Alvarado and Teodosia Duran (ark:/61903/1:1:NQ24-QZQ)

Costa Rica, registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1595-2022 — burial entry no. 814, 20 Jun 1880, San José: "Angela Alvarado, hija legitima de Ygnacio Alvarado y Teodosia Duran, de año y dos meses, murió de Alfericia" (ark:/61903/1:1:NQ5N-RXJ)
